thread:
emma: Heads-up — launching GA for the new Hosted "Edge" model family today. These are optimized for low-latency, short-context workloads (mobile/edge use cases). Streaming + function/tool-calling enabled out of the box. Docs live: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/edge-ga :tada:

raj: Nice! Is there an SDK/CLI change we need to communicate?

emma: Yes — bump to SDK v1.9.0 to get the convenience helpers. No required API key changes. To opt into the edge path you can either call the new endpoints or set the header `X-RW-Edge: true`. Example curl: 
```bash
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/edge.generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"edge-base-v1","input":"Summarize this..."}'
```

darren: Rollout details for infra folks: starting 10% of traffic now -> 50% in 6h -> 100% in 48h if no regressions. We'll route by model alias so customers using `edge-base` get the GA variant automatically. Cost note: edge models have slightly higher per-token cost due to low-latency provisioning.

sarah: Marketing plan: blog post + console banner + launch email scheduled for tomorrow 10:00 PT. Can we get two customer quotes? Who can share early access feedback? :eyes: 

emma: @darren, any customers in early access we should ping for quotes?

darren: A few PLG accounts tried the beta — I'll pull usage + perf snippets and DM you. Also — Dedicated/Private: not GA yet. Dedicated + Private support is targeted for a limited preview in ~2 weeks (config + KMS needs).

raj: Quick question re: function/tool-calling — do we support the same tool schema as hosted standard models? Need to validate tool auth scopes.

emma: Yes same function call schema. Tools that rely on network access will run under the customer's existing tool sandbox rules. We added an explicit permission flag in the API: `tools.allowed=true` in the model config.

ops-bot: [automated] console.banner.created — banner id=bnr_20260314_edge_ga scheduled for 2026-03-24T17:00:00Z

infra-bot: [deploy] edge-serving rollout batch #1 started (10% nodes). Track at https://status.redwood.ai/rollouts/edge-ga

raj: Migration note for engineers: rename endpoint usages from `/v1/generate` -> `/v1/edge.generate` to take advantage of latency paths. Backwards compatible but you lose edge perf.

emma: Beta endpoints will be deprecated in 30 days: `/v0/edge-beta` -> warn customers via console and email. We prepared a migration guide in the docs with code diffs.

sarah: I'll prepare a short internal comms pack (one-pager + GIF explainer) and post in #product-marketing by EOD.

emma: Thanks team — big win for latency-sensitive apps. Please surface any regressions in #eng-oncall and tag me if high-priority. :rocket:
